craft_notes: Sthāyin: śānta-vīra of effortlessness; vyabhicāri śama at scrutiny become standing. Sanskrit-first: vicāra-dvirātta (EXAMINE-THEN-EXAMINE-AGAIN — redoubled, kept doubled); anāyāsa (EFFORTLESS — kept). Rows: 9 (examine/examine double — redoubling IS the method), 1 (‘effortless’ closes — the fruit last). Close: ‘always, effortless’. Rupture: semicolon (scrutiny turns to standing). Rejected: single examine — killed: redoubling is the method; ‘rest’ for stand — killed: sthā stands. Read aloud: ex-AM-ine THE-self, THEN ex-AM-ine a-GAIN the-HYMNED-deed … IN-your-HYMN i-STAND — AL-ways, EFF-ort-less.

lines: Examine the self, then examine again the hymned deed;
in Your hymn I stand — always, effortless.
l4.sanskrit_cite: vimṛśya svātmānaṃ vimṛśati punaḥ stutyacaritaṃ | nikhilaviṣayajñānasamaye taditthaṃ tvatstotre 'ham iha satataṃ yatnarahitaḥ

reads_against.argmap: How is hymning effortless? → Self-examination redoubled makes hymning effortless.
c1_essence: Redoubled self-scrutiny: effortless standing in hymn.
